package.description: Free and Open-Source Visual Reactive Programming Language

en-US.description: Free and Open-Source Visual Reactive Programming Language
en-US.longDescription: Bonsai is a visual language for reactive programming. It is free and open-source, lightweight and easy to use, built on top of the .NET ecosystem with hundreds of dedicated packages and modules for interfacing with hardware, and for real-time processing, logging, and visualization of data streams.
